hook_b: Jio Platforms' quarterly profit hits *₹8,389 crore*, up 13.7%
tldr: Jio Platforms' Q2 profit rose 13.7% to ₹8,389 crore; shares climbed over 3%.

beats.what: Jio Platforms reported Q2 consolidated net profit of ₹8,389 crore on Oct 30.
beats.why: Profit grew 13.7% year on year for the September quarter, per The Hindu.
beats.care: On Jio? Watch whether stronger profits come with tariff changes; none announced here.

cards.title: 🆕 What's new
cards.body: Jio Platforms reported a 13.7% rise in consolidated net profit to ₹8,389 crore for the September 2026 quarter, announced on October 30 (The Hindu). Its shares climbed over 3% after the earnings. Revenue, ARPU and subscriber numbers were not in the summary we read.

cards.q: How good is Jio's network where you live?
By how much did Jio Platforms' Q2 net profit grow?
cards.why: Consolidated net profit rose 13.7% to ₹8,389 crore.

insight: Its shares rose over 3% after the results, per The Hindu.

learn.t: Consolidated net profit = profit of the company plus its subsidiaries, after all costs and taxes.

watch: Tariff moves and the next quarter's results.
